name: Semantic Transfer Function Design
aliases: Semantic Transfer Function Design — PCA-based Transfer Function Design
Semantic Transfer Function Design — PCA-based Transfer Function Design, Semantic PCA TF
definition: A framework that allows visualization experts to design high-level transfer function user interface with semantic information, where transfer function models described by sets of control points from many data instances of the same type are written as data points in a high-dimensional space, and semantic parameters are generated using principal component analysis (PCA) on these high-dimensional data points.
summary: Semantic Transfer Function Design uses PCA on expert-designed models to map high-level concepts like contrast to visual parameters, enabling intuitive control for non-experts.
